book.name: iLuku
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iLuku

content: Oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi ongyukwooblakwutsɛ mgbi emi iRoma
Dafi iYesu ngyɛlu odzɛ ogbɔɔgbɔ yi ibyi inggisɛ tsatsadu nɛ, o si kaka iKapenahun.
Mi igeli na, ongbidɔ mgbi ongyukwo oblakwutsɛ oka ngwu kpan itukwu saan dotse dzɛ kwɛkwɛ okwulu-kwulu.
Ongyukwo oblakwutsɛ mgbi emi iRoma nɛ si fwo odzɛ mgbi iYesu, o dɔ engyukwo emi iJuda angbeka esɔ gbɛɛ nu ma ka nyan no ba wa ngyɛlu ongbidɔ mgbi ongwu ootse.
Nɛ a ka tɛkyɛ nu iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Inggisɛ nɛ mina abɔ oyaaya mbi abu kyɛmɛ-kyɛmɛ.
Ikyekyɛ ɛsɛ mgbi eyi kpan itukwu, o di mbɛ eyi ozu okwakye.>>

Nɛ iYesu si wafɔ yi ama. Dafi iYesu dzɛ kwɛkwɛ okaka udɛ nɛ, ongyukwo oblakwutsɛ mgbi emi iRoma na dɔ emi okan angbeka esɔ nu ma ka nyan gbɛɛ, <<Otsɛ, ka nu ewabu okakewo wuba, ikyena ani mɛ ongwu abu ka ba onufozu mgbi ani ba.
Ani mɛ okɛ mbi abu ba. Nghanɛ gbɔ elodzɛ ta ootse mgbi ongbidɔ mgbi ani ka ngyɛ.

Ikyena ani abuen kpaa n li inggisɛ nbyidzɛ abɔ mfye, yi emi oblakwutsɛ mi abɔ ani, ni ani nya ongwunɛ gbɛɛ, <Lu,> o li lu. N di li gbɔ yi oka gbɛɛ, <Kwa> o di li ba. N di li nya ongbɛ mgbɛn gbɛɛ, <Kyungwɔnɛni,> o di li kyɔ ngha.>>
Ngwi iYesu fwo odzɛ nɛ nghanɛ, i kwulun ewo yan, o kyata inɛ mbi ibyi ama nkyan iyikpa ma si gbɛɛ, <<N nya ema, n tu itɔ oyɛyɛ onuunu nshewo itɔ nɛ ye ba, kwo mbi emi Israi kpaa.>>
Engyesɔ ntona yɛ lu udɛ ka tu ongbidɔ na yɛɛ saan.
IYesu kyile ongwɛ owakwadɛ mi ikwu
Ngwi i wa nyɛ nɛta iYesu wafɔ yi engwafɔɔn bɛyi ibyi inggisɛ le lu mi igeli ngwi a li kwun di iNai.
Dafi a dzɛ kwɛkwɛ okaka onufɛ ogalu nɛ, a kye ikwɔ tɔ le kɛ ongwu nli ongwɛ onyi kpokpo mgbi owakwadɛ. Nghanɛ ibyi inggisɛ mi ogalu na wafɔ yan.
Ngwi Otsɛ iYesu din nɛ, elela kyɔn won, o si gbɛɛ, <<Ka tsukwu ba.>>
Nɛ iYesu kɛ kwɛkwɛ kye abɔ gbo ogba, ama nsisi ntona kwulɛsɛ. O gbɛɛ, <<Ongwongyulɔ, kyato.>>
Nɛta inggisɛ ikwukwɔ ma si kyato sɔ nto wita ogbɔdzɛ, iYesu yilen nu onɔn.
Ama duu imio wo ma man a le tsɛ Imgbasho. A gbɛɛ, <<Oyegbɔ okwukwo tɔ mi idzidzɛ mgbi eyi: Imgbasho ba owa ya emidan abɔ.>>
Odzɛ mgbi iYesu si gbɔfwɛ kpatsɛ iJudia bɛyi ɛsɛ angbeka ama nwo otsee dɔ ma duu.
IYesu yi iJɔn okyɔ iBatisima
Engwafɔ mgbi iJɔn nyan ungwɔ ama ngwi iYesu kyɔ duu, o kwu efa ela,
o dɔ ma esɔ gbɛɛ nu ma kɛ ka byi Otsɛ iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Li abu li ongwu iJɔn gbɔgbɛɛ o kyɛma le ba ma, naadi ni eyi gbe inɛ byi inggisɛ oka idzidza?>>
Mi onɔ ngwi emi esɔ ntona ba mbi iYesu nɛ, a gbɛɛ, <<IJɔn okyɔ iBatisima dɔ eyi esɔ mbi abu gbɛɛ ni eyi wa byita gbɛɛ: <Abu li ongwu nkyɛ ka ba ma naadi ni eyi gbe inɛ byi inggisɛ oka?> >>
Mi onɔ na iYesu ngyɛlu ibyi inggisɛ ootse idzidza-dzidza, bɛyi onodzi ibwubwe, di nu ama nbinɛ dinɛ.

O si nu emi esɔ ntona uka gbɛɛ, <<Yidɔ lu ka nya iJɔn ungwɔ ngwi ema di diyɛ fwo: Ama nbinɛ yɛ le di, ama ngwu afɔ waawaa le kyikyɛ, ama ndɔ otsoma, otsoma mgbi ama ngyɛ, ama nkyadɔ le fwo, ama nkwulu le kyato mi ikwu, a le gbɔ Esɔ Osuse nya emi adzɛ.
Imgbasho ka kye mse dzɛ yi ali inggisɛ nfwa ani ba mi ungwɔ ama ani kyɔ mani.>>
Onɔ ngwi emi esɔ mgbi iJɔn lu nɛ, iYesu wita ogbɔdzɛ yi ibyi inggisɛ mi odzɛ mgbi iJɔn gbɛɛ: <<Li alungwɔ ngwi ema kɛ okwɛsɛ le ka di? Li atakwu ngwi awo le fan ntonaa?
Ki no li ngha ba ma, li alungwɔ ngwi ema kɛ le ka di? Li ongyulɔ nwo angwuto osusee? Ama nwo angwuto ofyunfyummya bɛyi ama ogye ɛsɛ a li to udɛ utɔ.
Wanɛ li alungwɔ ngwi ema tasɛ le ka di? Li oyegbɔɔ? Ɛɛn, ani le nya ema, o ngha oyegbɔ.
Nɛnɛ li ongwu a lɔ ungwɔ ikyen gbɛɛ:

content.text: ongwu nka teyi ka mɛ abu ofɛ mani.>

content: Ani le nya ema, inggisɛ ngwu ongyaa mba ma duu, onyi kpaa dzɛma nshewo ngha iJɔn ba; Nghaduu inggisɛ nli olɛlɛ mi esutɔ mgbi Imgbasho shewo nghan.>>
(Ali inggisɛ bɛyi ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ ngwu fwon duu, gbela Imgbasho, lubana iJɔn tsekise kyɔ ma iBatisima.
Kpaa emi iFarasi bɛyi ama oye ola fwa oweka mgbi Imgbasho mi ikye mgbi ama, ikyesinɛ a fwa onu iJɔn kyɔ ma iBatisima.)
<<Ma li alungwɔ ngwi ani ka kye inggisɛ emi etɔ nɛ mba yan? A to sinɛ?
A to dafi ɛngbɛ ama nto ifyidu le kwu ewoma ela gbɛɛ:
Lubana iJɔn okyɔ iBatisima ba, o li gye ungwogye ba, di li wa eneekwɔ ba; ema gbɛɛ: <Esɛ dɔn ikye.>
Ongwɛ Inggisɛ ba le gye diyɛ wa, kpaa ema li gbɛɛ: <Dii, o li inggisɛ okyɔ nggwɔ yi inggisɛ ofya ɛbyɛ di li oka ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ bɛyi emi ali ibwubwe.>
Nghaduu ozoyeye li tso otsitsi tɔ mbi ama nkyɛdɔn mani.>>
Owagbai ongyaa kye engyie kyiiYesu afɔ
Inggisɛ iFarasi oka bɔ iYesu ungwogye ongwi onɔdɛ mi udɛ mgban, o ka sɔkɛ imbe ogye ungwogye.
Onɔ ngwi ongyaa owagbai ngwu dzɛ igeli na, ka fwo dafi iYesu le gye ungwogye mi ozu mgbi inggisɛ iFarasi nɛ, o kye ikpɔkpɔ alabasta mgbi engyie ogbungbɛ,
wa kwulɛsɛ mi iyikpa iYesu le tsukwu kye etse kyin afɔ. Di kyi fwɔlu yi otu mgban, o kye ondu le kwon afɔ diyɛ kye engyie ogbungbɛ yawon afɔ.
Ngwi inggisɛ iFarasi ngwu bɔɔn ungwogye na di nghanɛ, o gbɔ yi ewon gbɛɛ: <<Inggisɛ nɛ ki li oyegbɔ yɔ, o ki ye itɔ ongyaa nkye abɔ le gbon ewo nɛ bɛyi iyi obube ngwi o dzɛyan nɛni.>>
Ta iYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<iSaimɔn, ani dzɛ yi odzɛ ngwi n ka gbɔ yi abu.>> O gbɛɛ, <<Gbɔka otsetse!>>
<<Inggisɛ onu mkpa oka dzɛ yi ama ngban mkpa nghi efa: Oka dzɛyan isule ideli eda, oka ma li isule ngwusefa dɔn iwyo.
Ama efa duu yagba okpaakpa ba, ta o dzɛ ma ta. Li emɛ ngwu inggisɛ onu mkpa na ka nghao kpan itukwu?>>
ISaimɔn nun uka gbɛɛ, <<N tsɛwɛ gbɛɛ, li ongwu o dzanta yi mkpa kwuba nani.>> IYesu gbɛɛ, <<O gbɔ ayin.>>
O si kyata inɛ kɛ mbi ongyaa na nya iSaimɔn gbɛɛ, <<Abu di ongyaa nɛ wɛ? Ani ba udɛ abu kpaa abu nu ani eni osaafɔ ba, kpaa ongyaa nɛ nu ani afɔ yɛɛ eneni yi etse, di kye fwɔlu yi otu mgban.
Abu ta ani angba yi ondu okwo ani ataka ba, kpaa ongyaa nɛ kyɛ onɔ ngwi ani ba mmɛnɛ ma jo, o tonya okye ondu kwo ani afɔ waba.
Abu kye engyie kyi ani ikye ba, nghaduu ongwu yɔ kye engyie ogbungbɛ kyi ani afɔ.
Hininɛ ani le nya abu gbɛɛ a dzanta yi ali ibwubwe kwuba, ikyesinɛ o tso okpitukwu kwuba. Kpaa inggisɛ ongwu a dzanta gwee, li tso okpitukwu gwee ta.>>
Ta iYesu nya ongyaa na gbɛɛ, <<A dzita abu yi ali ibwubwe mgbi abu.>>
Ingyoga angbeka ama nle gye ungwogye yi ama wita ogbɔ yi ewoma gbɛɛ, <<Nɛnɛ li emɛ ngwu ali ibwubwe kpaa o li dzɛ inggisɛ ta yan?>>
IYesu nya ongyaa na gbɛɛ, <<Oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi abu dulu abu watɔ, lu mi iyu.>>
